items.source: The vector store implementation can initialize the requisite schema for you, but you must opt-in by specifying the initializeSchema boolean in the appropriate constructor or by setting …​initialize-schema=true in the application.properties file. Alternatively you can opt-out the initialization and create the index manually using the Elasticsearch client, which can be useful if the index needs advanced mapping or additional configuration.
items.translation: 向量存储实现可以为您初始化所需的架构，但您必须通过在相应的构造函数中指定 initializeSchema 布尔值，或在 application.properties 文件中设置 …​initialize-schema=true 来选择加入。 或者，您可以选择退出初始化并使用 Elasticsearch 客户端手动创建索引，如果索引需要高级映射或额外配置，这种方式会非常有用。

items.source: Please have a look at the list of configuration parameters for the vector store to learn about the default values and configuration options. These properties can be also set by configuring the ElasticsearchVectorStoreOptions bean.

items.translation: 此外，您还需要一个配置好的 EmbeddingModel 豆（bean）。请参阅 EmbeddingModel 部分获取更多信息。

items.source: This section walks you through setting up the Elasticsearch VectorStore to store document embeddings and perform similarity searches.
items.translation: 本节将引导您设置 Elasticsearch VectorStore，用于存储文档嵌入并执行相似性搜索。

items.source: Elasticsearch is an open source search and analytics engine based on the Apache Lucene library.
items.translation: Elasticsearch 是一个基于 Apache Lucene 库的开源搜索和分析引擎。

items.source: Now you can auto-wire the ElasticsearchVectorStore as a vector store in your application.
items.translation: 现在您可以在应用程序中通过自动装配（auto-wire）ElasticsearchVectorStore 作为向量数据库。

items.source: The Spring Boot properties starting with spring.elasticsearch.* are used to configure the Elasticsearch client:
items.translation: 以 spring.elasticsearch.* 开头的 Spring Boot 属性用于配置 Elasticsearch 客户端：

items.source: cosine - Default, suitable for most use cases. Measures cosine similarity between vectors.
items.translation: cosine - 默认选项，适用于大多数用例。用于衡量向量之间的余弦相似度。

items.source: l2_norm - Euclidean distance between vectors. Lower values indicate higher similarity.
items.translation: l2_norm - 向量之间的欧几里得距离。数值越低表示相似度越高。

items.source: dot_product - Best performance for normalized vectors (e.g., OpenAI embeddings).
items.translation: dot_product - 归一化向量（例如 OpenAI embeddings）的最佳性能。

items.source: More details about each in the Elasticsearch Documentation on dense vectors.
items.translation: 更多详情请参阅关于稠密向量的 Elasticsearch Documentation。

items.translation: 您也可以在 Elasticsearch 中利用通用的、可移植的 元数据过滤器。
